newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares fall, but some cyclicals shine.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares fall, but some cyclicals shine.

text.p: The Norwegian all-share index fell on poor company results on Thursday but cyclical shares such as forestry group Norske Skog outperformed the market.
"Focus in Norway is on company first-quarter results for the time being, and not so much on Wall Street," one dealer said.
Oslo's Total index closed 0.31 percent lower at 1,093.41 points in moderate turnover of 841 million crowns, including 174 million in telecommunications group Nera ASA.
Nera said first-quarter pre-tax profits fell 0.75 percent to 26.4 million crowns because of reduced sales of transmission systems.

The share fell 15 percent last week after the company issued a profit-warning and tumbled another 20 percent following the result. Nera closed at 47.50 crowns following a five-for-one share split carried out as planned on Thursday.
Norske Skog rose 1.93 percent to 238 crowns while metals maker Elkem was up 0.72 percent at 139 crowns.
